title: The Story Dies
description: You escaped, but the evidence never made it out. The island continues unchanged.
explanation: The broadcast failed — either you didn't initiate it, or the evidence was too thin to verify. Without a credible archive, the story was suppressed before it could reach any journalist willing to act.
newsSegments: No confirmed reports from the offshore facility.
Authorities decline to comment on alleged island network.
Anonymous tip received but unverifiable — no documentation recovered.
The signal was lost before confirmation.

title: A Glimmer of Doubt
description: The broadcast went out, but the evidence was incomplete. An investigation begins, yet the network adapts.
explanation: You managed to broadcast something, but the archive was missing key corroboration. Reporters are cautious — the story runs, but without the critical documents it gets dismissed as speculation by those with the most to lose.
newsSegments: Breaking: anonymous broadcast claims offshore misconduct.
Investigation opened, but key evidence remains unverified.
Source has not been identified. Credibility questioned.

title: The Broadcast
description: The evidence chain was complete. Coordinated action follows across multiple jurisdictions.
explanation: The full archive — server records, security feeds, guest logs, financial traces — created an irrefutable chain of evidence. Fourteen journalists received verified copies simultaneously. The network had no time to suppress it.
newsSegments: Breaking: verified evidence archive broadcast from offshore facility.
Authorities confirm coordinated action against network operatives.
Multiple arrests reported across three jurisdictions.
Financial records show links to fourteen shell companies.

title: One Node
description: The broadcast succeeded. But the final fragment revealed the truth: the island was only one node in a larger network.
explanation: The full archive was broadcast, including the redacted memo marked NODE-7. Investigators are now working to identify the other nodes. The island facility is shut down — but the wider network is still operating.
newsSegments: Breaking: verified evidence archive broadcast from offshore facility.
Authorities confirm coordinated action. Arrests ongoing.
Classified fragment references additional sites. Scope unknown.
Investigators confirm the island was one of at least seven nodes.
